bio: Let yourself be taken on a journey courtesy of Marco Müller's Inspiration tasting menu, over the course of which he applies his own clear culinary style to skilfully build a narrative arc. The pleasant team will explain the ideas behind the dishes in a relaxed and informal way and are happy to answer questions. The menu features terrific ingredients such as Wagyu beef from Germany, the distinctive flavour of which is in a class of its own, and squid (an invasive species from the North Sea). From rabbit tartare or dry-aged carp, some of the dishes here are sure to surprise even experienced foodies at times – in an absolutely positive way! It is remarkable how the best products are showcased here while retaining their authenticity - everything looks so effortless and yet is full of complexit...
